_note: Files offered on the Downloads page. scripts/copy-data.mjs copies each 'path' (relative to data/derived) into public/data/ at build time, and the Downloads page shows the description, license and columns. Shared columns are defined once in 'common_columns'.

common_columns.entity: Which group the row describes: an institution key (for example yale, uconn), statewide (all 17, each article once) or statewide_no_yale / statewide_without_yale (articles with at least one author at one of the other 16, each once)
common_columns.period: complete for 2015 to 2025; incomplete for 2026, which is still being indexed
common_columns.works: Number of articles (articles and reviews), each counted once within the entity
common_columns.share: works divided by all articles for that entity (and year, if given)
common_columns.oa_category: Open access category: diamond, oa_fee_unconfirmed, gold, hybrid, bronze, green or closed (see the Methods page)
common_columns.rank_by_output: Rank within the entity by number of articles (1 = most)
common_columns.rank_by_closed: Rank within the entity by number of closed articles (1 = most)
common_columns.openalex_is_in_doaj: OpenAlex says the journal is in DOAJ
common_columns.openalex_is_oa: OpenAlex says the journal is fully open access
common_columns.doaj_has_apc: DOAJ: journal charges an article fee
common_columns.doaj_max_apc_usd: DOAJ: highest fee in US dollars, if given
common_columns.doaj_has_other_charges: DOAJ: other charges (for example submission or page fees)
common_columns.doaj_oa_start: DOAJ: year the journal became open access

groups.title: Main figures
groups.intro: Everything on the site's charts comes from these files. Built from OpenAlex by pipeline/s06_metrics.py and s12_green_proxy.py. Articles and reviews only, 2015 to 2025 unless a column says otherwise.

files.title: Free to read, 2015 to 2025
files.description: Articles free to read in any way (every category except closed), by institution and statewide.

columns.free_to_read: Articles in any category except closed

files.title: Free to read, by year
files.description: The same, for each year from 2015 to 2026. 2026 is incomplete.

columns.free_to_read: Articles in any category except closed

files.title: Open access categories, 2015 to 2025
files.description: Articles in each open access category, by institution and statewide.

files.title: Open access categories, by year
files.description: The same, for each year from 2015 to 2026.

files.title: Publishers
files.description: Articles and closed articles by publisher (imprints grouped under their parent company), top publishers per entity.

columns.publisher_parent_name: Top-level publisher in OpenAlex's publisher hierarchy

files.title: Fields
files.description: Articles and closed articles by OpenAlex field (a broad subject group, from each article's main topic).

files.title: Topics
files.description: Articles and closed articles by OpenAlex topic (a detailed subject label, one per article), top topics per entity.

files.title: Article fee estimates (APCs), 2015 to 2025
files.description: ESTIMATES of article processing charges, from journals' listed prices for gold and hybrid articles. Two methods, one row each.

columns.method: corresponding_author: articles where the entity is a corresponding author's institution; upper_bound_all_authors: any author at the entity
columns.paid_oa_works: Gold and hybrid articles counted by this method
columns.works_with_list_price: Of those, articles whose journal has a listed price in OpenAlex
columns.works_without_list_price: Of those, articles with no listed price (not included in the estimate)
columns.estimated_usd: Sum of listed prices in US dollars. An estimate, not a payment

files.title: Article fee estimates, by year
files.description: The same estimates for each year from 2015 to 2026.

columns.paid_oa_works: Gold and hybrid articles counted by this method
columns.works_with_list_price: Of those, articles with a listed price
columns.works_without_list_price: Of those, articles with no listed price
columns.estimated_usd: Sum of listed prices in US dollars. An estimate

files.title: Corresponding author coverage
files.description: How many articles have a corresponding author's institution recorded in OpenAlex. The corresponding-author fee estimate depends on it.

columns.with_corresponding_info: Articles with at least one corresponding institution recorded

files.title: Green open access opportunity (proxy)
files.description: Closed and bronze articles that could likely be made free in a repository, by a proxy based on what other authors in the same journal have done. Not a check of publisher policy.

columns.articles: All articles for the entity, 2015 to 2025
columns.closed_candidates: Closed articles with no free copy, in a journal that shows deposit evidence
columns.bronze_candidates: Bronze articles with no free copy except the publisher's page, in a journal that shows deposit evidence
columns.candidates_if_threshold_1: Candidates if one deposit in the journal counted as evidence (instead of three)
columns.candidates_if_threshold_10: Candidates if ten deposits were required

files.title: Books and book chapters
files.description: A count only. Books and chapters are not in the other figures.

columns.books_and_chapters_2015_2025: Books and book chapters with an author at the institution
columns.all_types_2015_2025: All work types in OpenAlex, for scale

files.title: Manifest
files.description: Snapshot date, build time and scope of this release.

groups.title: For librarians
groups.intro: An article list for planning repository outreach. It is not shown on the site and names no authors.

files.title: Repository candidates
files.description: Closed and bronze articles, 2015 to 2026, with no free copy except possibly the publisher's page, in journals that show deposit evidence. One row per institution and article. A proxy: check the publisher's current policy and any embargo before depositing.

columns.institution: Connecticut institution the article is credited to
columns.title: Article title
columns.year_complete: false for 2026, which is still being indexed
columns.journal_deposit_evidence_articles: Articles in this journal (2015 to 2025, worldwide) free only as an accepted manuscript in a repository other than PubMed Central or Europe PMC. Higher means stronger evidence

files.title: Read me for the candidate list

groups.title: Cross-checks
groups.intro: Comparisons between OpenAlex and other sources, used to test OpenAlex. Their numbers are never added to the main figures. Licenses differ by file.

files.title: Cross-check summary
files.description: The agreement figures quoted on the Methods page, with numerators and denominators.

files.title: Cross-check sample
files.description: The 510 articles checked against other sources: 30 per institution, 2015 to 2025, with a DOI.

columns.institution_key: Institution the article was sampled for

files.title: Unpaywall lookups

columns.upw_has_repository_copy: Unpaywall lists a free repository copy

files.title: OpenAIRE lookups

columns.oaire_n_records: OpenAIRE records found for the DOI

files.title: DOAJ journal checks
